comment: The Firefox core (plan vor-maschine R385 C): the exact tests the pinned Mozilla Firefox runs, file and full title. `required` is TS248-05's part and is never cut silently; `buildup` is added in the agreed order (probe-click, tabs, the other desktop dialog rows, the other portrait rows, visual.spec's desktop rows) while the merge gate's measurement stays under 5 min. playwright.firefox.config.ts runs exactly these; the gate compares its listing to them, test for test.
